content.text: Cooking with fire. Finishing with intention.

At Salt & Ember, fire is more than heat. It is a craft. Every dish is shaped by flame, smoke, and time, drawing out depth and character that cannot be rushed. Open flame cooking brings natural ingredients to life, creating bold flavors that feel grounded, intentional, and alive.
